title: ढुंगाको टुसाउने भानुभक्त पोखरेल {Dhungako Tusaune Bhanubhakta Pokharel}
nepali: प्रस्तुत आलेख भानुभक्त पोखरेलको काव्यकारितासँग सम्बन्धित छ । यसमा कवि पोखरेलको सङ्क्षिप्त परिचय, उनका प्रकाशित कृति तथा सम्पादनको चर्चा गर्नुका साथै उनका कवितामा व्यक्त विषयवस्तुगत, भावगत र शैलीगत ढाँचामा देखिने विविध प्रवृत्तिहरू, बिम्बप्रतीक योजना, छन्द एवम् लयविधान तथा उनको भाषाशैलीका सम्बन्धमा समीक्षा गरिएको छ । त्यसै गरी उनको ‘ढुङ्काको टुसो’ कविता सङ्ग्रहअन्तर्गत समाविष्ट पचास वटा कविताहरूलाई रचनाकाल क्रमगत ६ समूहमा राखेर विभिन्न कोणहरूबाट सङ्क्षिप्त विवेचना गरिएको छ । यस क्रममा पोखरेलका प्रारम्भिक कविताहरूमा रोमान्टिक भावधारा सल्बलाएको र त्यसपछिका कविताहरूमा उनले आफ्ना जीवनवादी तथा कर्मवादी चिन्तन, साहित्यकला सम्बन्धी आफ्ना सिर्जन मान्यता, प्रकृतिप्रेम, देशप्रेम, राजनीतिक बेथिति, सामाजिक विकृति, विसङ्गति, अन्याय, अत्याचार, भ्रष्टाचार, पश्चिमी संस्कृतिको छाडा प्रवृत्ति तथा मानवीय मूल्यमान्यताको ह्रासप्रति कठोर व्यङ्ग्य गरेका अनि उत्तरवर्ती कविताहरूमा नेपालीहरूको वीरताको गुणगान, शान्तिको कामना, काव्यकवितासम्बन्धी आफ्ना मान्यताहरूमा प्रौढता र स्पष्ट चिन्तन तथा कविताहरूमा परिष्कार, परिमार्जनतर्फ संशोधन परिमार्जनतर्फ पोखरेल आकर्षित देखिएका छन् भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: The present article relates to the poetic craft of Bhanubhakta Pokharel. In it, along with discussing a brief introduction to poet Pokharel, his published works, and his editorial contributions, a review is conducted regarding the diverse thematic, emotional, and stylistic tendencies observed in his poems, the scheme of imagery and symbolism, prosody and rhythmic structure, and his linguistic style. Likewise, fifty poems included in his poetry collection "Dhungako Tuso" have been placed into six chronological groups based on composition date and briefly examined from various angles. In this process, the conclusion is drawn that while a romantic emotional current stirred in Pokharel's early poems, in his subsequent poems he expressed his life-affirming and action-oriented thoughts, his creative convictions regarding art and literature, love of nature, patriotism, and severe satire against political disorder, social anomalies, absurdities, injustice, oppression, corruption, the dissolute tendencies of Western culture, and the decline of human values, and in his later poems Pokharel appears drawn toward singing praises of the valor of Nepalis, wishing for peace, maturity and clear thinking in his convictions on poetry, and the refinement and revision of his poems.

informal_english: This wee article takes a proper look at the poetic craft o Bhanubhakta Pokharel. In it, along wi a short introduction tae poet Pokharel, his published works, an his editorial work, there's a good review o the diverse thematic, emotional, an stylistic patterns in his poems, the scheme o imagery an symbolism, metres and rhythmic layout, an his way wi words. Likewise, fifty poems frae his poetry collection 'Dhungako Tuso' get split intae six chronological groups by when they were penned, an each lot gets a brief look frae different angles. In this process, the conclusion reached is that while a romantic feeling stirred in Pokharel's early poems, in his next batch he poured oot his life-affirming and action-oriented thoughts, his creative convictions on art an literature, love o nature, patriotism, and sharp satire on political disorder, social anomalies, absurdities, injustice, cruelty, graft, the wild ways o Western culture, and the decline o human values, and in his later poems Pokharel seems right drawn towards singin praises o the valor o Nepalis, wishin for peace, showin maturity an clear thinkin on poetry, an the refinement an polishin o his poems.
translator_notes: Source spells the collection as 'ढुङ्काको टुसो' (using ङ्क instead of ङ्ग). Contains editorial repetition 'संशोधन परिमार्जनतर्फ'. Strict 4-sentence structure preserved.
